2608.01630.title: RING: Retrieval-Internalized Generation for Continual Large-Scale Knowledge Injection
2608.01630.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves factuality but adds latency and engineering overhead at serving time. We propose RING (Retrieval-Internalized Generation), a holistic paradigm spanning both architecture and training that injects large-scale external knowledge into a \textit{Mixture-of-Memory Experts} and learns parametric search over this internal memory via reinforcement learning, removing the external retriever entirely. Training proceeds in three stages: continued pre-training injects new corpora into a Knowledge Expert via our novel \textit{Dual Causal Attention}; supervised fine-tuning teaches a ``search-then-answer'' pattern; and reinforcement learning with hierarchical rewards optimizes the routing-and-search policy over the parametric memory. Unlike prior parametric injection methods that pair internal memory with a fixed or rule-based retriever, RING {learns} its retrieval policy directly from task signals. We further frame RING theoretically as a search-free approximation to the classical RAG objective. To evaluate large-scale injection of genuinely {new} knowledge without test-time leakage, we further construct News-2025, a benchmark built from news strictly post-dating the base LLM's pretraining cutoff. RING matches or surpasses both search-based RAG and parametric injection baselines in accuracy and efficiency.
2608.01630.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）提高了事實性，但在服務時增加了延遲和工程負擔。我們提出了RING（檢索內部化生成），這是一個涵蓋架構和訓練的整體範式，將大規模外部知識注入到\textit{混合記憶專家}中，並通過強化學習學習對這個內部記憶的參數搜索，完全去除了外部檢索器。訓練分為三個階段：持續的預訓練通過我們新穎的\textit{雙因果注意力}將新語料注入知識專家；監督微調教導“先搜索再回答”的模式；而帶有層次獎勵的強化學習則優化參數記憶的路由和搜索策略。與以前將內部記憶與固定或基於規則的檢索器配對的參數注入方法不同，RING {學習}其檢索策略直接來自任務信號。我們進一步從理論上將RING框架設置為對經典RAG目標的無搜索近似。為了評估大規模注入真正的{新}知識而不產生測試時洩漏，我們還構建了News-2025，這是一個基於在基礎LLM預訓練截止日期之後的新聞建立的基準。RING在準確性和效率上與基於搜索的RAG和參數注入基準相匹配或超越。
